_meta.purpose: Single source of truth for every benefit dollar figure the site displays or computes with (Decision D4). Page prose, MDX components, and stateless tools all import from this file — no benefit figure is ever hard-coded elsewhere.
_meta.rule: every consumer of a benefit figure imports THIS file
_meta.conventions: Current-year entries carry value:null until verified against sourceUrl (verifiedAsOf set on verification). Entries prefixed _2025_ are known prior-year reference figures for context and test fixtures — never display them as current. Refresh events and SOPs live in content-ops/refresh-calendar.yaml (ssa-cola-oct, ssi-fbr-jan, ihss-wages-jan).

ssi_fbr_individual.note: SSI federal benefit rate, individual, monthly, 2026. ssi_child_allocation.note: Deeming allocation per ineligible child (couple FBR 1491 minus individual FBR 994). ssi_general_exclusion.note: SSI $20 general income exclusion (20 CFR 416.1112(c)(4)). Statutory, not year-keyed. Confirmed in the 2026-09-07 fact-check against POMS SI 01320.500 deeming mechanics; owner decision accepted snippet-level verification.

ssi_earned_exclusion.note: SSI $65 earned income exclusion, plus one-half of the remainder (20 CFR 416.1112(c)(5)). Confirmed in the 2026-09-07 fact-check against POMS SI 01320.500; owner decision accepted snippet-level verification.

ihss_wage_table.note: IHSS provider wages vary by county (58 counties) and change on different dates; the site links out to the CDSS table rather than mirroring it. [TBC] Confirm this CDSS URL still resolves before first use. If we ever embed per-county rates, they go here keyed by county with their own verifiedAsOf.

ccs_income_ceiling.note: CCS financial eligibility: family adjusted gross income ceiling (annual, state tax form). Verified 2026-09-07 against DHCS + county CCS eligibility pages. D4: this page's prose interpolates these rather than hard-coding them, so a threshold change lands in one place.

ccs_cost_share_percent.note: CCS alternative test: expected out-of-pocket medical costs for the child exceeding this percentage of family income. Percentage, not dollars. Verified 2026-09-07 against DHCS + county CCS eligibility pages. D4: this page's prose interpolates these rather than hard-coding them, so a threshold change lands in one place.
